resources.string: Detects when you open an app you have locked so Biometric App Lock can ask for your fingerprint. It reads which app is in the foreground. On package-installer, Settings, and device-admin screens it also reads the on-screen text to see if an uninstall, force stop, clear storage, or device-admin deactivation targets a locked app or Biometric App Lock. If you cancel the fingerprint prompt, it closes that system screen. It does not read what you type.
A few system settings are still off. Setup opens each screen for you.
Each step opens the right system screen. Turn the setting on, then come back. The next step opens on its own.
You\'re set. You can change these later from Review setup.
That settings screen could not be opened on this phone.
Add a fingerprint. This app will not open its settings or unlock apps without one. On the next screen, choose Fingerprint and follow the steps.

Android blocks the accessibility switch for apps installed from a file until you allow it. On the app info screen, tap the three-dot menu in the top corner, then Allow restricted settings. Confirm, then come back. If you do not see that menu item, the switch is probably already available.

Turn Biometric App Lock on. If you land on a list, open Installed apps or Downloaded apps, then Biometric App Lock, and switch it on. If the switch is greyed out, go back, open app info, tap the three-dot menu, and choose Allow restricted settings.
This asks Android to refuse uninstalling Biometric App Lock until you turn device admin off. On the next screen, tap Activate. It does not lock the phone or wipe it. You can skip this.
Allow unrestricted battery so the lock is not stopped in the background. On the next screen, tap Allow. If you get a list instead, open Biometric App Lock and choose Unrestricted. You can skip this.
No fingerprint is enrolled. Add one in Settings → Security → Fingerprint.
This device has no fingerprint sensor (or it is unavailable).
Fingerprint authentication is unavailable right now.
Confirm your fingerprint to view or change which apps are locked.
These settings stay locked until a strong biometric is available. Existing app locks are unchanged.\n\n%1$s
The previous key was revoked. Authenticate to set app lock up again.
Fingerprint enrollment changed. App lock now uses your current fingerprints.
Authentication could not be verified. Nothing was unlocked.
The secure hardware key could not be used. Nothing was unlocked.

When this is on, uninstalling a locked app or Biometric App Lock asks for your fingerprint. Force stop and clear storage for those apps ask too. Android also refuses to uninstall this app until its device administrator is turned off, and that screen asks for your fingerprint. The accessibility service has to be on for those prompts. Device administrator is used only to block uninstalling this app. It does not lock the phone, wipe data, or change other settings. Turning this switch off removes the device administrator. You have already confirmed your fingerprint to open this screen.
Biometric App Lock uses device administrator only so Android will not uninstall this app until you turn it off. It will not lock the screen, wipe the phone, or change other settings.
Uninstall protection is on. Deactivating device admin lets Biometric App Lock be uninstalled.
Could not change uninstall protection. Nothing was changed.
Uninstall protection will not see uninstall screens until the accessibility service is on.
Confirm with your fingerprint to continue. Cancel returns you to the home screen and stops this action.
